blocks.html: Short answer: Naklua is north of Pattaya, quieter and cleaner than the center. For the beach and resorts choose Wong Amat Beach; for seafood and local life pick Naklua (Lan Pho market); for a landmark base, near the Sanctuary of Truth; and to reach the city easily, south Naklua by North Pattaya.

faq.q: How is Naklua different from Pattaya?
faq.a: Naklua is north of Pattaya — quieter, cleaner and more local, with a fishing village and seafood markets, while Wong Amat is a calmer, prettier beach than Pattaya Beach. It suits travelers who want to relax but can still reach central Pattaya in a few minutes by car.

faq.q: Who is Wong Amat Beach best for?
faq.a: It suits couples, families and anyone wanting a quiet beach near the city, with mid-range to upscale beachfront resorts and a cleaner, less crowded shore than Pattaya Beach — though there is little shade and few loungers for rent, and the sand narrows at high tide, so check the tide times before you swim.

faq.q: Where is good seafood in Naklua?
faq.a: The Lan Pho market area in Naklua is known for fresh seafood, with markets and seaside restaurants to choose from at local prices, fresher than the tourist zones in town — a good spot to browse for seafood and have a waterside dinner.
